title: Jobsy Games
description: Jobsy Games is a premium GUI-based minigame plugin for Paper 1.21.11 that lets players instantly access fun arcade-style games like Tic Tac Toe, Flappy Bird, and Totem Clicker through a simple /games menu. Every game is fully interactive inside GUIs
body:
Jobsy Games is a premium GUI-based minigame plugin for Paper 1.21.11 that adds a fully interactive arcade system directly inside Minecraft. Players can use /games to access a sleek menu featuring 10 fun minigames like Tic Tac Toe, Flappy Bird, Totem Clicker, Memory Match, and more — all designed to be played entirely through custom GUIs with smooth animations, sounds, and rewards.

Each game gives players Vault money based on performance, creating a fun and rewarding progression system that keeps players engaged on your server. From fast reaction challenges to strategy-based games against AI, Jobsy Games turns downtime into an addictive experience.

⚠️ Requirements:

Vault (required for economy rewards)
EssentialsX (recommended for economy support and commands)

Perfect for survival, SMP, and hub servers looking to add fun, replayable content that boosts player activity and retention.
